pack.title: Raise promotion feedback
pack.description: Turn an indefinite delay into a specific next step.

scenarios.setting: Your manager postpones a promotion discussion for the third time.
scenarios.jab: Let's revisit this when things settle down.
scenarios.goal: Turn an indefinite delay into a specific next step.

replies.line: Let's book a date and agree on the criteria now.
replies.why: It asks for a review process instead of accepting an unspecified delay.
replies.delivery: Slow down on “date” and “criteria,” then leave room for an answer.

replies.why: Two concrete questions make the missing commitments visible.
replies.delivery: Slow down on “date” and “criteria,” then leave room for an answer.

replies.line: I understand the timing is difficult; could we schedule a review and document the criteria?
replies.why: It acknowledges the constraint while requesting an actionable plan.
replies.delivery: Keep “I understand the timing is difficult” warm and unhurried; finish the request clearly. ” then leave room for an answer.

replies.line: My calendar can handle a real date better than “someday.”
replies.why: Gentle humor highlights the delay without questioning your manager's character.
replies.delivery: Keep “My calendar can handle a real date better” light; let the joke stand without repeating it. ” then leave room for an answer.

followUp.line: I'm asking for a review date and clear criteria, rather than a guaranteed promotion.
followUp.why: It distinguishes a fair process from a promised outcome.
followUp.delivery: Slow down on “date” and “criteria,” then leave room for an answer.
